Participations and loan receivables in companies with registered office or place of management abroad may, under the following conditions, be recognized in the year of acquisition at a value of 90% of the acquisition costs:
a) The funds are used for a permanent establishment abroad which serves the distribution, setting up or servicing of goods produced in Austria.
b) In the case of corporations, there must be
— significant participations (participation of more than 25% in the share capital) acquired upon formation or a capital increase, or
— shareholder loans from substantial shareholders, if the loans were granted upon formation or a considerable expansion of the company.
c) In the case of partnerships in which the partners are considered co-entrepreneurs, significant participations within the meaning of letter (b) acquired upon formation or a considerable expansion of the company must exist.
